rules: every canonical biographical or research claim must resolve to at least one public source id
every source registry document and admitted source record must declare visibility=public
every source class must be present in allowed_source_classes
do not infer private facts from public omissions
do not infer endorsement affiliation or authorship from repository naming
source authenticity does not prove every claim contained in the source
preserve disagreement between credible sources instead of silently choosing one
do not reproduce copyrighted paper text beyond brief quotation where permitted; prefer metadata and original summaries
the repository screenshot is motivation only and is excluded from canonical claim support
